Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL221959 to include parent and all salts. Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id, then docs on compound_records.doc_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target CHEMBL2971 and IC50 activities with standard_units nM. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Do not limit rows.
